schedule.step_indexing: gsplat receives the 0-based iteration index i; checkpoint/log step = i + 1
schedule.means_lr: exponential decay from 1.6e-4 x scene_scale to 1.6e-6 x scene_scale at step 10000 (means_lr_final_ratio 0.01)
schedule.other_lr: constant: scales 5e-3, quats 1e-3, opacities 5e-2, sh0 2.5e-3, shN 1.25e-4
schedule.densification: duplicate/split and prune opacity < 0.005 at i = 600, 700, ..., 7400 (i > 500, i % 100 == 0)
schedule.large_gaussian_pruning: max axis > 0.1 x scene_scale pruned at the same refinements only for i > 3000 (gsplat ties it to reset_every): i = 3100 ... 7400
schedule.opacity_reset: none: gsplat 1.5.3 DefaultStrategy condition `step % reset_every == 0 & step > 0` is never true; not compensated
schedule.after_densification: i = 7500 ... 9999: optimization only, fixed Gaussian set
schedule.validation_and_selection: validation every 1000 steps and at 10000; checkpoint chosen by mean validation PSNR over usable faces
schedule.short_trial_difference: l4-short-001 densified at i = 600 ... 2400 and never pruned large Gaussians (i > 3000 never reached before refine_stop_iter 2500)
